verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a general REST API ('push or pull data'), SDKs, and a CLI for subscribers and campaigns. It also lists dynamic segments as a product feature. Nothing documents API endpoints to create or update groups, segments, or tags, or to list their members. Generic API access and a UI-level segments feature don't establish this specific programmatic capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them
